WITH payments_per_order AS (
  SELECT
    ppo.order_id,
    ABS(SUM(ppo.payment_value)) AS order_payment_total
  FROM order_payments ppo
  GROUP BY ppo.order_id
),
reviews_per_order AS (
  SELECT
    rpo.order_id,
    AVG(rpo.review_score) AS order_review_score
  FROM order_reviews rpo
  GROUP BY rpo.order_id
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown') AS product_category_name_english,
  ABS(AVG(oi.price)) AS avg_price,
  ABS(AVG(oi.freight_value)) AS avg_freight_value,
  ABS(AVG(ppo.order_payment_total)) AS avg_payment_value,
  ABS(AVG(rpo.order_review_score)) AS avg_review_score,
  ABS(SUM(oi.price)) AS total_revenue,
  ABS(COUNT(oi.order_item_id)) AS total_units_sold,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
LEFT JOIN payments_per_order ppo ON ppo.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN reviews_per_order rpo ON rpo.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown')
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 30;
